_notes: HORO-1381 sub-ticket 6 — cross-product canonicalization-vector agreement test.

This is a fully schema-v1-valid 24-field event, not the canonicalization spec's own worked example (that example is missing adapter_version, gap_reason, and imported, per Finding 9 -- it cannot be validated against schema_v1 or deserialized by Horologium's/Libra Governor's typed Event structs).
Fixture invariants -- forced by specific product/validator constraints, do not silently "fix" these:
payload_classification=metadata_only: Eltanin's PayloadClassification enum has only MetadataOnly.
transport_state=pending: Eltanin's TransportState enum has only Pending.
decision_mode=observe, scope_id=null, actual_action=allow, would_action=deny: SCHEMA-12 (scope_id only under enforce), MODE-10, and the observe+deny-is-malformed rule.
origin_profile=personal (and profile=personal): avoids the corporate => permanently_ineligible latch in Circinus's and Ophiuchus's pydantic validators.
All 24 ADR-0012 section 3 fields are present, including adapter_version, gap_reason, and imported.

integrity is present and fully populated ({canonicalization, content_hash:{alg,value}, prev_event_hash:null, signature:null}); content_hash is set to this vector's own real expected value. Stripped before hashing by all five products, so it cannot affect the result.

Every string value is restricted to printable ASCII containing no '"' and no '\\', which is what makes serde_jcs (Horologium), json.dumps(ensure_ascii=True) (Circinus), json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False) (Ophiuchus + this harness), and sorted serde_json (Eltanin, Libra Governor) provably byte-identical.
product=circinus is arbitrary -- pinned for continuity with the canonicalization spec's worked example. Do not "fix" this to any other product value; any value would work structurally.
